statement: OpenAI's published chronology dates its start as a nonprofit to November 2015. It publicly announced OpenAI as a nonprofit AI research organization on December 11, 2015. The announcement named Sam Altman and Elon Musk as co-chairs.
OpenAI launched ChatGPT publicly on November 30, 2022, as a research preview. ChatGPT was free to use during the preview.
OpenAI launched GPT-5 in ChatGPT and on its API platform on August 7, 2025.
At OpenAI DevDay on October 6, 2025, the company reported that ChatGPT had more than 800 million weekly users. Sam Altman delivered the opening keynote.

In the recapitalization announced on October 28, 2025, OpenAI's nonprofit became the OpenAI Foundation and the for-profit became a public benefit corporation called OpenAI Group PBC. The OpenAI Foundation retained control and has the right to appoint and replace all OpenAI Group directors.
At the closing of OpenAI's October 28, 2025 recapitalization, Microsoft reported an approximately 27 percent stake in OpenAI Group PBC on an as-converted diluted basis, including all owners.
sourceTitle: Microsoft — Joint partnership announcement filed with the SEC (October 28, 2025)
